cases.question: According to the 2023 Q3 Apple filing, what were net sales and net income for the three months ended July 1, 2023?
According to the 2023 Q3 Amazon filing, what were net sales and operating income for the three months ended September 30, 2023?
Compare the three-month net sales reported in the filings labeled 2023 Q3 for Apple and Amazon.
required_facts: Apple net sales were $81,797 million for the period ending July 1, 2023.
Amazon net sales were $143,083 million for the period ending September 30, 2023.
The reporting periods end on different dates.

cases.question: What did the NTSB determine was the probable cause of the Piper PA-22-150 accident near Tallahassee?
required_facts: The pilot misjudged obstacle clearance on final approach.

cases.question: What visibility and ceiling were reported for the Reims F172M accident near Chevroux, France?
required_facts: The ceiling was broken at 200 feet above ground level.

cases.question: How many participants were planned for the single-center oral chronic graft-versus-host disease study using mesenchymal stem cell dressings?
For the spinal-injury virtual-reality rehabilitation feasibility study, what was the intended intervention schedule and target recruitment?
required_facts: The schedule was at least three times weekly for 12 weeks.
